title: Few-class Fidelity: Evaluating Explanations of Real-conditions CNN classifiers with Optimized Perturbations
abstract: arXiv:2606.28391v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The wide use of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) in numerous domains and real-world classification applications is justified by their high precision and automation speed, helping users concentrate on higher-expertise tasks. To better understand the models and avoid bias during deployment, eXplainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) techniques can be used after training. But as the list of XAI solutions expand, comparisons between them diverge, and consensus over their evaluation cannot be reached. This paper proposes a variation of Fidelity-based XAI metrics, with a focus on real-conditions applications, where the number of classes is often low. The approach generates in-distribution, uncertainty-provoking perturbations, to ensure proper measurement of the XAI methods faithfulness. translated_title: 少类别保真度：使用优化扰动评估真实条件下CNN分类器的解释
translated_abstract: arXiv:2606.28391v2 公告类型：replace-cross 摘要：卷积神经网络（CNN）凭借其高精度和自动化速度，在众多领域和现实世界的分类应用中得到了广泛使用，帮助用户专注于更高专业性的任务。为了更好地理解模型并避免部署过程中的偏差，可以在训练后使用可解释人工智能（XAI）技术。但随着XAI解决方案数量的不断增加，它们之间的比较出现分歧，无法就其评估达成共识。本文提出了一种基于保真度的XAI指标的变体，重点关注类别数量通常较少的真实条件应用。该方法生成分布内的、能引发不确定性的扰动，以确保对XAI方法忠实性的正确测量。作为评估框架实用性的证明，将其与以人为中心的物体定位和分割指标进行了比较。一旦应用……
tldr: 本文提出了一种面向少类别真实条件下CNN分类器的基于保真度的XAI评估指标变体，通过生成分布内的、引发不确定性的优化扰动来更准确地衡量XAI方法的忠实性，并与人类中心的物体定位和分割指标进行了对比验证。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a variation of Fidelity-based XAI metrics for few-class real-conditions CNN classifiers, generating in-distribution, uncertainty-provoking optimized perturbations to properly measure the faithfulness of XAI methods, validated against human-centric object localization and segmentation metrics.
